run_actionlint_linter: run actionlint on GitHub Actions workflow YAML files using the actionlint binary
check_file_with_actionlint: check a single workflow file for lint issues using the actionlint binary
parse_actionlint_output: parse actionlint stdout output into structured LintMessage objects using the RESULTS_RE regex
run_command_with_timing: run a subprocess command with debug logging and execution timing
create_lint_message: create a LintMessage named tuple with path, line, char, code, severity, and description fields
